p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u049/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9a3f7388.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    occupied = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    if not occupied:
        return out
    lo, hi = min(occupied), max(occupied)
    gaps = [i for i in range(lo + 1, hi) if all(v == 0 for v in grid[i])]
    if gaps:
        # The separator between the two parts is the full blank row.
        r = max(gaps, key=lambda i: sum(any(v != 0 for v in grid[j]) for j in range(lo, i)) + sum(any(v != 0 for v in grid[j]) for j in range(i + 1, hi + 1)))
        out[r] = [3] * len(grid[r])
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
